text:
zoe: Quick poll: office mascot name ideas? we need something between 'Planty McLeaf' and 'Chairman Meow'. suggestions!

mike: 'Sir Sheds-a-Lot' for the ficus.

alia: Vote for 'Leaf Erickson' (pun intended). also i drew a tiny mustache on a sticky note.

ben: I nominate 'Staples' (he's very punctual).

zoe: Haha keep them coming. will do a 1-minute vote at 4pm. loser buys coffee.

ops-bot: Poll created: "Mascot Name" Options: Planty McLeaf / Chairman Meow / Sir Sheds-a-Lot / Leaf Erickson / Staples. Expires in 2h.

mike: also - can we please not name it after a person who sits in row 3. HR might have opinions.

alia: agreed. honorary desk plant only.

ben: okay fine. staples it is unless there's a dramatic write-in.

zoe: dramatic write-in accepts emojis. bring your best.

ops-bot: Reminder: Poll closes in 10 minutes.

zoe: closing poll in 5. get your votes in! :voting_hand:

mike: voted. good luck, Staples.

alia: voted for Leaf Erickson. may the freshest leaf win.

ben: last-minute vote for 'Chairman Meow' because chaos.

ops-bot: Poll results: Staples (2), Leaf Erickson (1), Chairman Meow (1), Sir Sheds-a-Lot (0), Planty McLeaf (0). Winner: Staples.

zoe: Staples it is. new office mascot name: Staples. ceremonial nameplate to follow. Loser (Leaf Erickson voters) buys coffee tomorrow.

ben: proud to be a victor. long live Staples. :tada:
